# 3 Axial Skyrmions
- The change in only one of the pion fields' sign under reflection leads to a π phase difference as opposed to all three fields' sign changes in refs.[3, 12, 7], facilitating a stronger analogy with monopole scenarios.
- At a radial distance of s/2 from the center, both Skyrmion and antiSkyrmion profiles reach zero, allowing their seamless integration, with vacuum conditions prevailing outside each core.
- Originally established using a straightforward ansatz (3.7), the subsequent conditions employed a more elaborate rational map ansatz detailed in ref. [11], featuring an axially symmetric charge n map.
